saw_lines: Coffee buyers stick with one blend and one machine, then reorder the same bag without comparing.
So the sale is won or lost in the first line, where a buyer checks if this is their usual blend.
Your 8 of 11 copy ads open on one app invite, so name new openers from your product, like the office machine and sugar free sweetness, and test them against it.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 3 Nov 2026
points: 8 of your 11 copy ads open on the same app invite, so buyers who scroll past that line never reach the rest. Test new openers: the office machine on the desk, the sugar free question, and the subscription restock.

One exact copy runs in 8 of your 11 ads, so the same text reaches the same buyers again and again. Rewrite the opening line and creative in each of those 8 ads, with a different product shot in every one.

None of your 30 ads shows a proof number, so a first time buyer has nothing to trust before clicking. Collect one real figure, like your review count or orders shipped, and open the next batch with it.

19 of your 30 ads are catalog feed ads with no story, so the feed shows a product grid, not a reason to stop. Add story ads built around the Office machine on a real desk and a short Kaffeereport clip.

ads_1: Office machine, sugar free and subscription openers, each with its own product shot
soc_1: Brand social strategy across Facebook, Instagram, Pinterest, Twitter and Youtube
